name: P6 Sheets export — manual gated pilot (INACTIVE)

parameters.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $root=$env:OHORA_P6_REPO_ROOT; $db=$env:OHORA_P6_RAW_DB; if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($root) -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($db)){throw 'P6 repo/db environment variables required'}; $script=Join-Path $root 'raw_v2\three_api_sheets_export.py'; if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $script -PathType Leaf) -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $db -PathType Leaf)){throw 'Missing export script or RAW database'}; $after=$env:OHORA_P6_SHEETS_AFTER_ID; if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($after)){$after='0'}; if($after -notmatch '^\d+$'){throw 'Invalid cursor'}; & python $script --db $db --after-id $after --limit 500; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}"

parameters.jsCode: const items=$input.all();if(items.length!==1)throw new Error('Expected one export response');const raw=items[0].json;if(raw.exitCode!==0)throw new Error('RAW export failed');let data;try{data=JSON.parse(raw.stdout)}catch{throw new Error('Invalid RAW export JSON')}if(data.schema_version!=='p6-sheets-export-v1'||!Array.isArray(data.rows)||!Number.isSafeInteger(data.after_id)||!Number.isSafeInteger(data.next_after_id)||typeof data.has_more!=='boolean')throw new Error('Unexpected export contract');if(data.rows.length===0){if(data.has_more)throw new Error('RAW integrity gap: do not advance cursor');return []}let prev=data.after_id;const seen=new Set();for(const row of data.rows){if(!Number.isSafeInteger(row.observation_id)||row.observation_id<=prev||typeof row.observation_key!=='string'||!row.observation_key||seen.has(row.observation_key))throw new Error('Invalid observation sequence');prev=row.observation_id;seen.add(row.observation_key)}if(prev!==data.next_after_id)throw new Error('Cursor mismatch');return data.rows.map(row=>({json:row}));

// Manual validation gate only: do NOT persist checkpoint here. The operator must verify all rows in Sheets first.\nconst rows=$input.all();return rows.map(x=>({json:{...x.json,checkpoint_update:'NOT_AUTOMATED',instruction:'After verifying all upserts, set OHORA_P6_SHEETS_AFTER_ID to the acknowledged next_after_id before the next run.'}}));
